relationships.subject: Capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsazepine, a TRPV1 antagonist, effectively reduced nociceptive hypersensitivity and downregulated the overexpression of phosphorylated CaMKIIα in rats with DNP.

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA alleviated heightened sensitivity to pain caused by nociceptive stimuli and downregulated the level of TRPV1, p-CaMKIIα, and phosphorylated cyclic adenosine monophosphate response element-binding protein (p-CREB) in DNP rats.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicated that the CaMKII/CREB pathway on SCDH is located downstream of TRPV1 and is affected by TRPV1.

key_findings: TRPV1 and p-CaMKII are overexpressed and co-localized in spinal dorsal horn of DNP rats
Electroacupuncture alleviates DNP via the TRPV1-mediated CaMKII/CREB pathway
